title: Excavations in Palestine, 1932-3: Umm Qatafa Cave
author: (round-up; work directed by R. Neuville)
location_note: Umm Qatafa cave, Wadi Khareitun; no map reference; placed by name. Not in a held cave area.
notes: Autumn 1932 season below the 1928 levels: fallen-rock layer cleared, flake industry beneath. Prehistoric deposit only.

features.subtype: prehistoric cave with stratified deposits (Tayacian below Acheulean)
features.period: Tayacian (Lower Palaeolithic), below the Acheulean levels
features.quote: the excavator cleared this fallen rock and found beneath it an industry
